The story revolves around the numerous problems that a new daughter-in-law has to face when she has to live in a joint family, especially the tantrums of her mother-in-law.
Movie:- Ek Din Bahu Ka (1983)
Starcast:- Suresh Oberoi, Vijay Arora, Swapna, Saeed Jaffrey, Shubha Khote, Lalita Pawar, Om Prakash
Directed by:- Desh Gautam
Produced by:- Firoza Nadiadwala
Music by:- Bappi Lahiri
